nodes.label: VPN Config Sales via Telegram Bot
nodes.rationale: Bot sells 3X-UI VPN configs with TON cryptocurrency payment support. Combines Telegram bot interface, crypto payments, and VPN panel management into one product.
nodes.norm_label: vpn config sales via telegram bot

nodes.label: TON Non-Bounceable Address Requirement
nodes.rationale: TON wallet address must be non-bounceable (UQ... prefix, 48 chars) for receiving payments. Bounceable addresses (EQ...) are for smart contracts only and may cause payments to bounce.

nodes.label: BigInt Money Rule
nodes.rationale: All wallet balances stored as BigInt in Toman (IRT). Never use Number for money to avoid floating-point precision errors.

nodes.label: Fail-Fast Config Validation
nodes.rationale: Config validation runs at startup before any bot logic. Process exits immediately on invalid env vars, preventing silent misconfiguration.

nodes.label: Bot Middleware Chain Order
nodes.rationale: Middleware must be wired in exact order: session → conversations → userSyncMiddleware → handlers. Session must precede conversations plugin requirement.

nodes.label: Admin Silent Drop Pattern
nodes.rationale: Non-admin updates hitting admin handlers are silently dropped without error messages. Callback queries always answered to clear Telegram loading indicator even when dropped.

nodes.label: Persian User-Facing Strings Policy
nodes.rationale: All text shown to Telegram users must be in Persian (fa-IR). Code comments and log messages remain in English.

nodes.label: Adapters Interfaces-Only Pattern
nodes.rationale: src/adapters/ contains interfaces and types only — no implementations yet. Implementations go in the same directory alongside interfaces when ready.

nodes.label: XUI Cookie Jar + Auto-Relogin Pattern
nodes.rationale: 3X-UI uses session cookies for auth. Implementation needs a cookie jar (e.g. tough-cookie + axios-cookiejar-support) and auto re-login on 401/403 responses because the panel invalidates sessions.
